chapters.summary: Council staff welcomes attendees to the Committee on Children and Youth vote, asks that electronic devices be silenced, and instructs that no one approach the front desk chair.
chapters.title: Committee staff opens hearing and gives housekeeping instructions

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Good morning and welcome to today's New York City Council vote for the Committee on Children and Youth.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: At this time, we please ask that you silence all electronic devices.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: At no point in time is anyone to approach the front desk chair.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: You may begin.

chapters.summary: Chair Althea V. Stevens introduces herself and the committee vote on proposed Resolution 142-A, thanking Council Members Felder and Joseph for attending on time.
chapters.title: Chair Stevens opens the vote on Resolution 142-A and recognizes colleagues

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: Good morning.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: I'm Councilman Valtia Stevens, Chair of New York City Council on Committee on Children and Youth.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: Thanks for joining us this morning for our committee vote on the proposed resolution number 142A.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: Special shout out to my colleagues who are here on time, Councilmember Felder and Councilmember Joseph.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: So we are starting expeditiously and really about that.

chapters.summary: Chair Stevens describes Resolution 142-A, sponsored by Council Member Kevin Riley, which calls on New York State to pass and the Governor to sign legislation establishing the Center for Fatherhood Initiatives under the Office of Children and Family Services.
chapters.title: Chair Stevens explains Resolution 142-A and the Center for Fatherhood Initiatives

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: But back to this resolution, Resolution 142A, sponsored by my colleague Kevin Riley.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: This resolution calls for New York State to pass and for the governor to sign legislation that would establish the Center for Fatherhood Initiative under the Office of Children and Family Services.

chapters.summary: Drawing on her career in the provider space, Chair Stevens says children with engaged, present fathers experience stronger cognitive and behavioral development, higher self-esteem, and improved academic performance.
chapters.title: Chair Stevens cites research on father engagement and youth outcomes

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: I have spent much of my career in the provider space, directly serving young people and families in my community.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: In that work, I have seen firsthand the connection between strong potential involvement and positive youth development outcomes.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: Research supports that children whose fathers are engaged, present, and active in their lives experience positive youth development outcomes.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: This benefit includes strong cognitive and behavioral development, self-esteem, high self-esteem, and improved academic performance.

chapters.summary: Chair Stevens notes that many fathers face systemic barriers to engaging in their children's lives, especially co-parenting and non-custodial parents, those incarcerated or in reentry, and young teen fathers who often have few resources.
chapters.title: Chair Stevens highlights systemic barriers facing fathers

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: Yet many fathers fail.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: systemic barriers that prevent them from fully engaging in their children's lives.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: This is particularly true for those who are co-parenting or non-custodial parents, those who are incarcerated or undergoing reentry, and young teen fathers.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: New fathers often have few resources to turn to.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: To turn at to in very moments where they are required the most support in their journey in new parents.

chapters.summary: Chair Stevens says she is glad the resolution is being voted on and hopeful the new state office will strengthen family dynamics and community, thanking committee staff and her District 16 team.
chapters.title: Chair Stevens expresses hope for the new state office and thanks staff

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: I'm glad that this resolution is being brought to a vote in our committee today.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: I am hopeful that this new state office will provide a critical resource necessary to strengthen family dynamics and build community.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: I'd like to thank committee staff for their hard work in preparing for this vote and extend an excited...

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: An excellent team back in District 16, and a thanks to the excellent team back in District 16.

chapters.summary: Chair Stevens reads remarks for Council Member Kevin Riley, who is unable to attend, expressing gratitude to the committee for elevating Resolution 142 and excitement that the bill is coming to a vote.
chapters.title: Chair Stevens delivers remarks on behalf of Council Member Riley

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: I've also been asked to deliver remarks on behalf of Councilmember Riley, who is unable to join us today.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: Thank you, Chair Stevens.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: That would be me.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: You're welcome, Councilmember Riley.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: I want to give you my gratitude to the committee for elevating Resolution 142.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: This request that New York State establish a dedicated resource center for fathers.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: I'm excited to see this bill come to a vote at the council.

chapters.summary: The remarks thank Senator Bailey and Assemblymember Diaz for their leadership in Albany, and describe how fathers navigate difficult social barriers without inherited knowledge of available services.
chapters.title: Riley remarks thank state leaders and describe fathers' barriers

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: I'm encouraged to see the conversation continue in Albany, and I want to thank Senator Bailey and Assemblymember Diaz for their leadership as they continue to advocate for this program to come across the finish line in the state.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: Just a special.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: Shout out to Assembly Medeas.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: He's one of my assembly members.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: Look at him.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: As a son and a father now, I have come to understand that the father, fathers often navigate difficult social barriers than mothers and do not always have inherited knowledge of the services available for them and their children.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: FALA certainly can benefit from.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: Tools to be involved and support their children's lives.

chapters.summary: The remarks say the centers would offer statewide support including mentoring, job training, and parent supports to help fathers overcome barriers and strengthen families, calling the resolution a step toward healthier communities.
chapters.title: Riley remarks outline services the fatherhood centers would offer

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: Those centers will offer statewide support for areas such as mentoring, job training, parent supports, truly helping fathers overcome barriers and strengthening families.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: This resolution is a great step towards fostering healthier communities and a more resilient city.

chapters.summary: Chair Stevens thanks colleagues who supported the legislation and Elizabeth Arts with the legislative division, then concludes Riley's remarks and turns the floor over to the clerk for the roll call.
chapters.title: Chair Stevens thanks colleagues and legislative division, turns to roll call

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: Thank you to all my colleagues who have supported this legislation and Elizabeth Arts with the legislative division who helped to ensure that the resolution acknowledged their future positive outcome of this proposal.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: And with that, I am that with conclusion of both my my remarks for Councilmember Riley.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: And I will now turn it over to the clerk for call the roll.

chapters.summary: Committee clerk Ben Jacobs calls the roll on Resolution 142-A; Chair Stevens and Council Member Joseph vote aye, with Council Members Osei, Williams, and Felder recorded.
chapters.title: Clerk Ben Jacobs conducts roll call vote on Resolution 142-A

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Ben Jacobs, committee clerk.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Roll call vote on resolution 142A.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Chair Stevens.

utterances.speaker: Althea V. Stevens
utterances.text: Aye.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Councilmember Joseph.

utterances.speaker: Rita C. Joseph
utterances.text: Aye.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Councilmember Osei.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Councilmember Williams.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Council Member Felder.

chapters.summary: The clerk announces the vote of three in the affirmative, none in the negative, and no abstentions, and declares Resolution 142-A adopted. The vote is then closed.
chapters.title: Resolution 142-A adopted with three affirmative votes

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: With a vote of three in the affirmative, none in the negative, and no abstentions, the item is adopted.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: The vote is closed.

summary: The Committee on Children and Youth convened a hearing on Resolution 142-A, which calls on New York State to establish a Center for Fatherhood Initiatives under the Office of Children and Family Services.
Chair Althea V. Stevens delivered opening remarks on the importance of father engagement and read remarks on behalf of sponsor Council Member Kevin Riley.
The committee held a roll call vote and adopted Resolution 142-A with three affirmative votes, none opposed, and no abstentions.
title: Committee on Children and Youth
topic: Establish the Center for Fatherhood Initiatives under the Office of Children and Family Services
